experiment_note: V1 and V3 use the same MLP architecture, feature ordering and nominal training configuration. V1 was trained using the original training dataset including no-hand samples. V3 was trained using hand-present samples only. Both models are evaluated on the exact same hand-present validation samples. Each model uses its own training-derived normalization statistics. This comparison evaluates the effect of the changed training data pipeline, although other training-run variability cannot be ruled out.
